question: In the morning, Bruno had 50 crates at his farm stand, but 29 of them were empty, so he set those aside and kept only the full ones. Each full crate held 4 watermelons. In the afternoon a neighbour dropped off 73 more watermelons for him to sell. In the evening, at the festival, Bruno cut every watermelon into 7 slices and sold each slice for 8 dollars, selling all of them. How many dollars did Bruno make from the slices?

The Hillcrest orchard has 68 apple trees in each of its 6 rows. This year every tree yielded 9 baskets of apples. The orchard also has 25 pear trees, which are not being harvested yet. The picking crew works for half a day before stopping for lunch. The apple baskets were packed 3 to a crate, and every crate sold to the wholesaler for 6 dollars. How many dollars did the orchard receive for the apple crates?

A bottling line fills 136 bottles every minute, and it ran for 9 minutes before the first break. The bottles were packed into cases of 6 bottles each. The plant employs 14 workers on this line. To the cases from the run, the foreman added 70 cases left from yesterday and 72 cases from a second line. Each case weighs 3 kilograms; the floor scale reads in grams, so the foreman converted the case weight into kilograms before doing his sums. How many kilograms did all the cases together weigh?

In the morning Jun had 68 dollars, and his grandmother matched it so that he had twice as much. He then spent 112 dollars on a jacket. In the afternoon he earned 64 dollars washing cars. In the evening at the airport he exchanged all of his dollars for pesos at 6 pesos per dollar. He then paid 429 pesos for a taxi. How many pesos did Jun have left?

A small cafe bought 160 eggs and used an equal number on each of 5 days. Each egg made one omelette, and every omelette sold for 9 dollars, so the cafe sold that many omelettes on the fifth day. The cafe has 12 tables. On the fifth day it also took 43 dollars for coffee and 41 dollars for pastries; the till records everything in cents, but the owner converts the figures to dollars for her notebook. That evening she paid 60 dollars for the milk delivery out of the day's money. How many dollars did the cafe have left from the fifth day's takings?

Dev arrived at the arcade with 101 tokens. He used 94 tokens on racing games and then 6 more on a claw machine. He fed his last token into a ticket machine that pays out 9 tickets per token. A lucky spin then doubled his tickets, leaving him with twice as many. Each ticket is worth 5 cents at the prize counter; the price board there is written in dollars, so Dev converted the prices into cents to compare. He spent 17 cents' worth of tickets on a sticker, while his friend Nia, who had played beside him, was left with fewer cents' worth of tickets than Dev. How many cents' worth of tickets did Dev have left?

Mara had 103 glass beads for a necklace. She lost 22 of them when the bag split, found 11 more under the sofa, and gave 7 to her cousin Tobias. Each of her remaining beads weighs 8 grams. She threaded them all onto a chain with a 40-gram clasp and 3 grams of silk cord. Tobias made his own necklace, but it weighed less than Mara's. How many grams did Mara's finished necklace weigh?

Ivan tracked the money in his charity raffle fund from start to finish. Each ticket cost 76 cents plus a 29-cent handling fee, and Ivan added everything to the fund in cents even though the bank statement shows dollars. Every family bought 5 tickets, there were 7 families on each street, and Ivan covered 5 streets. He found a 13-cent coin at the bottom of the collection box and added it to the fund. His co-organiser Petra, who ran a separate fund, collected less than Ivan. Ivan then paid 2986 cents from the fund for printing. How many cents were in Ivan's fund after paying for printing?

Zoe walks dogs for 25 dollars a walk. She does 7 walks each week and worked for 5 weeks. She usually walks 4 dogs at a time. A grateful owner gave her a 55-dollar bonus. Her booking app reports earnings in cents, so Zoe converted the amount to dollars before paying her bills. She then paid 560 dollars in rent and 246 dollars for leads and treats. How many dollars did Zoe have left?

Leila's flock started the year at 163 sheep. In spring 14 lambs were born, then she sold 4 old ewes, and later she bought 14 sheep at auction. Her neighbour Hamid's flock of 120 sheep is smaller than Leila's. At shearing time every sheep in Leila's flock gave 5 kilograms of wool. How many kilograms of wool did Leila's flock produce?

A village pump was installed a dozen years ago and moved 99 litres of water per hour. A new motor raised its flow by 18 litres per hour, a wider pipe added 36 litres per hour, and a second inlet added another 59 litres per hour. The pump then ran at that final rate for 8 hours a day for 7 days. How many litres of water did the pump move in those 7 days?

Farah took 232 photos on her trip and found 51 more on her old camera. She ordered 4 prints of every photo; the print shop quotes prices in cents, so she converted the bill into dollars. She sorted all the prints into 4 equal stacks and kept 1 stack, giving the other stacks to relatives. She then sold each print in her stack for 4 dollars at a craft fair. Her brother Karim sold prints at the same fair but earned less than Farah. How many dollars did Farah earn from her prints?

Ben had 50 stickers and gave half of them to his sister. He is 9 years old. At the school swap table he traded each remaining sticker for 3 cards. He then bought 77 more cards at the shop. He gave 142 cards to the charity drive. How many cards did Ben have left?

Priya hosts a daily podcast and keeps her recording log in minutes. Each weekday she records 82 minutes of interviews, then adds 39 minutes of commentary and 33 minutes of listener calls. She records exactly this much on each of 5 weekdays. During editing that week she cuts a total of 217 minutes from the combined footage. She never converts her log to hours, even though sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of footage remain after editing?

Marco and Lena are playing an arcade game and comparing scores. Marco starts the second level with 131 points, while Lena has only 98 points at that moment. Marco collects a bonus worth 65 points, then loses 110 points when his character falls into a pit. A power-up then applies a multiplier of 9 to his score. He is hit by a trap that costs him 558 points, and finally the end-of-level bonus applies a multiplier of 4 to his score. Lena's high score from last week was 3000 points. How many points does Marco have at the end of the level?

In the morning Hana collected 115 eggs from her hens, while her neighbour Tomas collected only 88 from his. On the way to the market, 46 of Hana's eggs cracked and had to be thrown away. In the afternoon she sold every remaining egg for 4 dollars each. Tomas also paid her 16 dollars that he owed her. In the evening she spent 255 dollars on chicken feed. How many dollars did Hana have left?

Nadia has 86 sheets of stickers, while her brother Omar has 60 sheets, so she has more than him. Nadia has been collecting stickers for half a year. She buys 16 more sheets at the shop, and every sheet holds 4 stickers. Omar gives her 6 loose stickers as well. She gives away 187 stickers to her classmates, and later finds 13 stickers in her desk drawer. How many stickers does Nadia have now?

Rafael started the spring with 37 sunflower seeds in a jar. His aunt gave him 19 more seeds, and a neighbour added another 39. He gave 17 seeds to his classmates and planted 72 seeds along the fence, where the garden bed is 4 metres long. He sowed every seed still in the jar in pots on his windowsill, and each of those seeds grew into a plant that produced 8 new seeds by autumn. How many seeds did Rafael collect from the windowsill plants?

At a small workshop, each of 6 workers assembles 166 bicycle bells in a day. Every day, 59 bells from the day's output fail inspection and are scrapped. The workshop runs 6 days a week, and a large order takes 3 weeks of this work to complete. When packing the order, the manager adds 21 spare bells from the storeroom. Each bell weighs 40 grams, and the manager writes the shipping weight in kilograms rather than grams, since a thousand grams make one kilogram. How many bells are shipped in the order?

In the morning, Yusuf's fruit stall had 208 oranges, more than the 150 oranges on Amira's stall next door. A farmer dropped off 30 more oranges, and by midday Yusuf had sold 109. In the afternoon a second delivery added 54 oranges, and he sold 131 more. In the evening he sold each remaining orange for 6 rupees. How many rupees did Yusuf earn in the evening?

Dana, the treasurer of the village library fund, records the fund in whole dollars, converting any cents she receives because a hundred cents make one dollar. The fund began the year with 153 dollars. A bake sale added 64 dollars. A regional foundation then granted enough money to make the fund exactly 4 times as large as it had just been. The library spent 519 dollars on new shelves, and a late donation of 52 dollars arrived in December. How many dollars are in the fund at the end of the year?

In the morning, 8 volunteers each collected 108 cans of food for the town food drive, working for 5 hours. In the afternoon a grocery shop donated 24 more cans. The organisers then split all the cans equally between 2 food banks. In the evening, the Elm Street food bank divided its share equally among 3 shelters, one of which is the Harbour shelter. How many cans did the Harbour shelter receive?

Hiro collected 110 empty bottles for a refund drive, more than the 95 bottles his classmate Aiko collected. Neighbours gave Hiro 70 more bottles, but 8 broke in his cart. A cafe donated another 54 bottles. At the depot, which is 3 kilometres from his house, 137 of his bottles were rejected as the wrong type and 11 more were found to be cracked. The depot pays 4 cents for every accepted bottle, and Hiro later converts his total from cents to dollars, knowing that a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did Hiro receive at the depot?

Tariq took 37 photos on his holiday and deleted 17 of them that were blurry. He ordered 6 prints of every photo he kept. He divided all the prints equally into 6 envelopes and kept just 1 envelope, mailing the others to relatives. From that envelope he gave 18 prints to his grandmother. He liked the remaining prints so much that he had them reprinted until he had triple that number. How many prints does Tariq have now?

At the arcade, Zoe started with 12 game tokens, while her friend Ben started with 9, so Zoe had more. Zoe used 5 tokens on the racing game. She then fed each of her remaining tokens into a machine that pays out 3 prize tickets per token. She traded 14 tickets for a keyring. Ben, who had already finished playing, gave Zoe his 74 tickets. The prize counter lists its prices in dollars even though the tickets are earned one at a time, and Zoe knows that a hundred cents make one dollar. How many tickets does Zoe have now?
